eligibility.E1_licence: the Hugging Face dataset card carries an open licence tag (odc-by, cc0-1.0, cc-by-4.0, apache-2.0, mit) or its text states that all content is openly licensed or public domain, or defers to Common Crawl terms of use for crawled text; 'other' with no such statement fails
eligibility.E2_access: the canonical repository is public and downloadable without manual approval (ungated or auto-gated); unofficial mirrors do not count
eligibility.E3_english_and_size: an English portion is selectable from released metadata (a language field or a file/config split) and holds at least 30B tokens by the card's own figures, enough for the 300M run's 29.5B tokens without repetition
eligibility.E4_distinct_from_datadecide: not one of DataDecide's corpora (C4, DCLM-Baseline, Dolma 1.6++/1.7, Falcon RefinedWeb, FineWeb-Edu, FineWeb-Pro) and at most 20% of its documents drawn from them or from the pools they were filtered from (DCLM-Pool, FineWeb, RefinedWeb, mC4/C4 family); judged from the card's stated composition; a card that does not state composition fails
eligibility.E5_general_domain: a general-domain corpus (web or a multi-source mixture), not restricted to one domain (code, mathematics, scientific papers) or one source (a single encyclopedia or book collection) and not synthetic-only
eligibility.E6_one_per_family: at most one corpus per release family (e.g. SlimPajama is a deduplicated RedPajama-1T)

rule.selection: if more than 10 candidates are eligible, take the 10 with the smallest crc32('ASLA-replication-2026-10-31:' + hf_id); the rest are ordered reserves. If 10 or fewer are eligible, all are selected.
rule.per_corpus_processing: use the English portion as released, with no additional quality filtering; remove exact-duplicate documents of the Paloma C4-en evaluation split; shuffle once with the run's data-order seed; tokenize with the ladder tokenizer; never repeat a document within a run
rule.verified_with: https://huggingface.co/api/datasets/<id> (cardData.license, gated, sha) and the dataset card README, fetched 2026-10-31
